description: Compute end-to-end pipeline latency for synthetic e2e probe logs (eventName == synthetic.e2e.probe).

script.source: if (ctx.eventName == 'synthetic.e2e.probe' && ctx._ingest_ts_str != null) { def emitted = ctx.attributes?.probe_emitted_at_unix_millis; if (emitted != null) { long ingest = Instant.parse(ctx._ingest_ts_str).toEpochMilli(); ctx.probe_e2e_latency_ms = ingest - (long)emitted; } }
